meanings.experience: one receipt binds the asset kind, the recomputed identity and digest, the kind conformance, and the admission disposition ADMITTED is returned only when identity, digest, conformance, references and human approval all close
the digest is recomputed from the exact supplied bytes a claimed digest that differs from the recomputed digest returns ASSET_DIGEST_DIVERGED
an identity already present in the registry returns ASSET_IDENTITY_COLLIDES an unsupplied registry inventory returns REGISTRY_INVENTORY_UNSUPPLIED rather than treating every identity as unique

the archetype declares its nodes, its edges and its terminal dispositions an archetype that does not declare nodes, edges, branch geometry, convergence geometry, semantic precedence and terminal structure immutable under instantiation returns ARCHETYPE_GEOMETRY_NOT_IMMUTABLE
the profile declares its required mechanics and its provider requirements a profile declaring scenario topology returns MECHANIC_PROFILE_DECLARES_TOPOLOGY
the connection declares which mechanic requirements it satisfies and the bounds it satisfies them under a connection declaring scenario topology returns PROVIDER_CONNECTION_DECLARES_TOPOLOGY

design, execution and physical vocabulary remain in their own registries an asset claiming an authority belonging to another vocabulary returns VOCABULARY_AUTHORITY_INVERTED, because a provider that names the circuit has stopped being a provider
every referenced authority is admitted and exact any unadmitted reference returns REFERENCED_AUTHORITY_UNADMITTED
admission proceeds only on an explicit APPROVE an absent, held or rejected disposition returns HUMAN_ADMISSION_NOT_APPROVED, because zero findings is not approval
both receipts are byte-identical a divergent replay returns REGISTRY_ADMISSION_REPLAY_DIVERGED rather than the later receipt
